add_sample.title: Add a calibration sample
add_sample.description:
Read these at one moment, with the device charging — the error does not appear otherwise. {count} sample(s) recorded so far.

Give the reported charge power, then at least one true/reported pair. Supplying both the true input and true output also derives the true charge power, which checks the device's own charge reading.

*True input* is a plug meter at the wall socket. *True output* is what the load itself reports. The reported values are this integration's Input power, Output power and Charge power sensors.

error.sample_needs_a_pair: A sample needs a true and reported value for the output, the input, or both — otherwise there is no error to measure.
